instincts.trigger: Adding new feature to Flutter app
instincts.action: Create feature/presentation/pages/ only. No domain/data layers needed unless refactoring.
Add to appropriate controller. Use /public/ prefix for permitAll, else JWT required.
Use React.lazy() for code-splitting. Add route in App.tsx. Use @dekat/web-api-client for API calls.
Use status machine: HELD -> PENDING_PAYMENT -> PENDING_APPROVAL -> CONFIRMED -> CHECKED_IN -> IN_SERVICE -> COMPLETED. Also: CANCELLED, NO_SHOW, EXPIRED.
Use formatRupiah() in Flutter (minor units/sen). Use Intl.NumberFormat with id-ID in TypeScript.

promotion_policy: Promote only repeated, validated, project-neutral lessons.
